reports.title: Valvoline Inc. Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2027 Outlook
section: “Looking ahead to fiscal 2027, we expect another year of strong growth,” Flees added. "Our outlook assumes no change in the supply environment — stable availability and continued elevated product costs. Our team will keep executing with discipline, staying focused on serving our customers, growing our network and managing costs. We remain confident in the underlying strength of our business and the long-term value we can create for shareholders.”
Information regarding the Company’s outlook for fiscal 2027 is provided in the table below:

System-wide SSS growth1 | 5.0% - 7.0%
System-wide store additions1 | 190 - 220
Net revenues | $2.25 - $2.35 billion
Adjusted EBITDA1 | $595 - $625 million
Adjusted EPS1 | $1.85 - $2.05
Capital expenditures | $245 - $265 million

desk.headline: Sales up 22% to $554m, below estimates; adjusted EPS $0.42 in line; fiscal 2027 outlook slightly under consensus
results: Q4 sales grew 22% to $554m, helped by the Breeze Autocare stores, with same-store sales up 9.4%.
Adjusted EPS dipped to $0.42 from $0.45 and margins narrowed as product costs rose; GAAP EPS fell to $0.08.
Fiscal 2026: sales up 21% to $2.06bn, adjusted EPS up 11% to $1.76, and the 20th straight year of same-store growth.
Free cash flow for the year was $204m; total debt is $1.6bn after a refinancing.
Buyback authorisation raised to $500m; 61 stores added in the quarter, 337 in the year.

guidance.summary: First fiscal 2027 outlook: sales of $2.25–2.35bn and adjusted EPS of $1.85–$2.05. The midpoints sit slightly below analyst estimates; it assumes product costs stay high.

points: Same-store growth came mostly from higher ticket (pricing, premium products, extra services); visit numbers were flat to slightly up.
Lubricant costs rose about 60%, recovered through price rises; costs have been stable for a few weeks.
Gross margin expected to fall 2–2.5 pts in the first half of fiscal 2027, about 1 pt for the full year.
Breeze integration ahead of plan; visits softening among lower-income customers.
Franchise store openings lag targets; higher interest and tax weigh on EPS. Leverage 2.6x EBITDA.
call.source: Call coverage: GuruFocus via Investing.com and Investing.com, 19 Nov 2026 (no prepared remarks filed)

watch: Gross margin in the first half of fiscal 2027 as high product costs persist.
Customer visit trends, especially among lower-income drivers.
Pace of franchise store openings against the 190–220 target.
